demonstrated.explanation: This is part of the production system. It is shown here so you can see what Provisa does, but it is not available in the sandbox.

environment_management.title: Environments are a production feature
environment_management.body:
An environment is a complete, separately governed copy of your model: its sources, tables, policies, masking rules and grants. Teams change the model in dev, review it in staging and serve from prod, merging one environment into the next with a diff, an approval and an undoable history.

Your sandbox is one of these environments, made for you alone. Creating, merging, deploying and retiring them belongs to the organization that owns them, so this page is shown for reference and acts on nothing.
